Only create directories for playlist thumbs when they have been requested for download

Bugfix for 2acd1d555ef89851c73773776715d3de9a0e30b9

Closes #8372

commit a40e0b37dfc8c26916b0e01aa3f29f3bc42250b6
Author: bashonly <88596187+bashonly@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Sun Oct 22 18:05:22 2023 -0500

    [core] Only ensure playlist thumbnail dir if writing thumbs (#8373)
    
    Bugfix for 2acd1d555ef89851c73773776715d3de9a0e30b9
    
    Closes #8372
    Authored by: bashonly

diff --git a/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py b/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py
index 8e11646d3..d066efdc7 100644
--- a/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py
+++ b/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py
@@ -4242,7 +4242,7 @@ class YoutubeDL:
             self.write_debug(f'Skipping writing {label} thumbnail')
             return ret
 
-        if not self._ensure_dir_exists(filename):
+        if thumbnails and not self._ensure_dir_exists(filename):
             return None
 
         for idx, t in list(enumerate(thumbnails))[::-1]:
